$description: BYOP (Build You Own Pi) design-only extensions. Merge by unique token path with ../onevra/tokens.json. Values cite Onevra/MyGo source file:line or are marked product extension. The workbench.* namespace keeps its earlier name for compatibility. Not yet synchronized to CSS or Penpot.

meta.name: BYOP Extensions
